content.title: About
content.content: Potato flour is a dry powder made from peeled and dried potatoes. It has a neutral taste, light texture, and is used as a wheat‑flour substitute, especially in gluten‑free recipes.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Potato flour contains more starch than wheat flour, making it an excellent thickener.
It has been known since ancient civilizations, where it was used to make breads and flatbreads.
The flour is naturally gluten‑free, suitable for people with celiac disease.
Unlike pure potato starch, the flour retains some dietary fiber and minerals.
When baked, it gives a crispier crust to baked goods.

items.title: Rich in starch
items.content: Starch provides a quick source of energy and helps stabilize blood sugar when consumed in moderation.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Potato flour contains virtually no fat, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Contains vitamin C and potassium
items.content: Small amounts of vitamin C and potassium support immune function and electrolyte balance.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: The dietary fiber present aids regular bowel movements.

items.title: Gluten‑free
items.content: Ideal for those with gluten intolerance or celiac disease.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Because of its high starch content, potato flour can raise blood sugar quickly.

items.title: Potato allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to potato.

items.title: Low protein content
items.content: Unlike wheat flour, potato flour is low in protein, so it is often blended with other flours.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Use potato flour for baking breads, pancakes, cakes, and as a thickener for sauces, soups, and purees. When substituting wheat flour, use about 1.2–1.5 parts potato flour for each part wheat flour.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark place. For long‑term storage keep it in the refrigerator or freezer to prevent mold growth.
